text.content:
Type: City / Kingdom
First Visited: Session 0

Description

A modern city-state kingdom that consolidated power through wars, expanding and absorbing neighboring city-states from the fracturing @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.BgvmBR3xqE7I4SUZ]{Middle Kingdoms}, including @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion} (now @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}).
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} fought for Beaconhold in these consolidation wars.
Beaconhold has reached the practical limits of its expansion.
The kingdom is built around the last known intact Farus Lucis — a dormant beacon tower that serves as a symbol of ancient connection and inherited legitimacy.
The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Luciferian faith} is the state religion here — supported but not mandated.
Other religions are tolerated but not supported, and perhaps frowned upon.

The Nature of the Kingdom

Like other modern kingdoms, Beaconhold essentially controls its capital city and immediate surroundings.
Some kingdoms have a main city and a few minor cities.
Outside the cities and main roads lies the wild.
The kingdom may claim mountains, valleys, and regions, but only truly controls the capital, main roads, inns along those roads, and checkpoints and fortresses.

Notable Features

  • Last known intact Farus Lucis (dormant beacon tower)
  • Seat of the crown, ruled by the King of Beaconhold (name TBD)
  • A grand cathedral of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Church of Lucifer}, where @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} was raised as an orphan
  • The @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} are border or hinterland regions of this kingdom
  • Granted fiefdoms in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} to war veterans like @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} during its expansion, though these were largely left to self-govern

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County} — A minor but strategically placed county bordering the capital
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} — Border region to the south
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} — Border region to the east
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Havens Reach} — Port town on the border between the kingdom, the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers}, and the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium}

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Sir Roderic Lightbearer} — Raised in the capital city
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} — Rules @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as Roderic's homeland
